comments.body_html: After a couple hours of troubleshooting, finally got this to work.

comments.author: 5uperliminal
comments.body_html:
I had DSX on Steam as well as Amands Controller and while Amands Controller was working, somehow DSX 3.0.5 was not registering this mod even though the UDP port was open. DSX Steam has an option to use v2, so I tried that and I finally got both this mod and Amands to work.

EDIT: I just realized you put “DSX 2.X only works for now” in the changelog of an earlier build. Maybe you should also put it on the main description.

comments.author: Props
comments.body_html: Version 3 does not have support for custom triggers via UDP yet.. so basically no game mods work with it yet. I have added the note on the overview page.
